CDK AWS Cloud 
Development Kit 
AWS’s Cloud Development Kit is used to 
define cloud infrastructure as code (IaC), 
which enables the use of scripting 
languages like TypeScript (AWS, n.d.). 
This method of defining infrastructure 
enables the use of version control and 
easier roll back capabilities. 
TypeScript Language for CDK The choice of TypeScript over other 
scripting languages such as Python and 
JavaScript, was down to the advantages 
regarding type safety, ensuring that 
services will deploy correctly. 
WebStorm TypeScript IDE WebStorm is the JetBrains solution for 
Typescript, offering code competition, 
diagramming, and refactoring tools, 
which are particularly beneficial while 
using TypeScript (JetBrains, 2024).  
Docker Containerization 
Platform 
Docker is a crucial tool for its primary 
features of creating consistent and 
repeatable environments via the use of 
containers (Docker, n.d.). This feature 
alone offers significant benefits while 
deploying code to the cloud, by ensuring
